summary: Feed s102_single is degraded: 56.3% of traffic (1705/3030 frames) is VXLAN-encapsulated and forwarded without decapsulation. SIEM sees only outer VTEP headers, all other visibility checks are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is passing through overlay VXLAN traffic (1705 frames, UDP port 4789) without stripping the outer header, likely tapped on a VTEP uplink or configured to forward encapsulated traffic as-is.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM without VXLAN decapsulation sees only outer VTEP IPs/UDP 4789 and VXLAN VNI, not the inner Ethernet/IP 5-tuple. Correlation, filtering and detection rules fail for 56.3% of traffic, severely reducing detection coverage even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping VXLAN outer Ethernet/IP/UDP header at the packet broker exposes inner headers so the SIEM can parse true source/destination endpoints and apply its detection logic without native tunnel support.
